Interesting! The first two variants (`CACAAAACCAUACGCG...` with pos9=U,pos11=C) drop domain 1's outer stem entirely (bp_distance 8) — the rest of the structure stays intact. The outer stem of domain 1 is the only unstable part.

This confirms domain 1's outer stem (positions 7-11 / 32-35) is the whole problem. The flanking 5' region `CACAAAA` + the junction is interfering. Domains 2 and 3 fold perfectly because they're flanked by structured regions, but domain 1's 5' flank is too flexible.

Key realization: domain 1 starts at position 7. The 5' flank (positions 0-6) is unstructured and the outer stem of domain 1 (positions 7-8 / 34-35) competes with extending into the flank. Let me run finish from one of these distance-8 variants which has a cleaner starting point — maybe finish can rebuild domain 1 correctly.
